config.label: Python Data Analysis
config.description: Analyze data using Python with pandas and numpy
config.code:
import json
import statistics

# Get input data from previous node
input_data = input_json.get('data', [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30])

# Perform statistical analysis
results = {
    'count': len(input_data),
    'sum': sum(input_data),
    'mean': statistics.mean(input_data),
    'median': statistics.median(input_data),
    'stdev': statistics.stdev(input_data) if len(input_data) > 1 else 0,
    'min': min(input_data),
    'max': max(input_data),
    'range': max(input_data) - min(input_data)
}

# Calculate quartiles
sorted_data = sorted(input_data)
results['q1'] = statistics.median(sorted_data[:len(sorted_data)//2])
results['q3'] = statistics.median(sorted_data[(len(sorted_data)+1)//2:])

# Output results
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
output_json = results
